source:
Keep the moments. Remember the voices.

LifeTalea gives family stories a private place on your tablet. Begin with one photograph, a few written lines, or a voice recording. No LifeTalea account is required.

SAVE THE STORY BEHIND THE PHOTOGRAPH
Add photographs, tags and an optional location you enter yourself. Choose a year, month, exact date or unknown date. Organise memories into albums and mark favourites.

MAKE ROOM FOR THEIR VOICE
Record, pause, resume and play a spoken story. Audio stays in private app storage. The free tier supports recordings up to three minutes. Microphone permission is requested when you choose to record. Command phrases currently support English. Voice commands and spoken playback depend on installed device services; touch and text alternatives remain available.

FOLLOW YOUR FAMILY'S CHAPTERS
Browse saved memories in a timeline. Search written stories, tags and manually edited transcripts. Create scrapbook drafts, arrange pages and add captions.

PRESERVE A COPY YOU CONTROL
Create a local backup and explicitly choose whether to include photographs and recordings. Restore validates the archive before importing. Keep exports and passphrases somewhere safe.

OPTIONAL PREMIUM
Premium is designed as a one-time purchase for unlimited albums, longer recordings, local PDF keepsake export and encrypted archive creation. Actual local prices will be supplied by Amazon. Existing stories remain accessible without Premium.

DEVELOPMENT STATUS
This listing is a draft. Automatic transcription is not configured. Worldwide translations, required device tests and Amazon purchasing verification are incomplete. No cloud sync is offered. Do not publish this draft as a finished product listing.

Keep the moments. Remember the voices.

LifeTalea gives family stories a private place on your tablet. Begin with one photograph, a few written lines, or a voice recording. No LifeTalea account is required.

SAVE THE STORY BEHIND THE PHOTOGRAPH
Add photographs, tags and an optional location you enter yourself. Choose a year, month, exact date or unknown date. Organise memories into albums and mark favourites.

MAKE ROOM FOR THEIR VOICE
Record, pause, resume and play a spoken story. Audio stays in private app storage. The free tier supports recordings up to three minutes. Microphone permission is requested when you choose to record. Command phrases currently support English. Voice commands and spoken playback depend on installed device services; touch and text alternatives remain available.

FOLLOW YOUR FAMILY'S CHAPTERS
Browse saved memories in a timeline. Search written stories, tags and manually edited transcripts. Create scrapbook drafts, arrange pages and add captions.

PRESERVE A COPY YOU CONTROL
Create a local backup and explicitly choose whether to include photographs and recordings. Restore validates the archive before importing. Keep exports and passphrases somewhere safe.

OPTIONAL PREMIUM
Premium is designed as a one-time purchase for unlimited albums, longer recordings, local PDF keepsake export and encrypted archive creation. Actual local prices will be supplied by Amazon. Existing stories remain accessible without Premium.

DEVELOPMENT STATUS
This listing is a draft. Automatic transcription is not configured. Worldwide translations, required device tests and Amazon purchasing verification are incomplete. No cloud sync is offered. Do not publish this draft as a finished product listing.

Keep the moments. Remember the voices.

LifeTalea gives family stories a private place on your tablet. Begin with one photograph, a few written lines, or a voice recording. No LifeTalea account is required.

SAVE THE STORY BEHIND THE PHOTOGRAPH
Add photographs, tags and an optional location you enter yourself. Choose a year, month, exact date or unknown date. Organise memories into albums and mark favourites.

MAKE ROOM FOR THEIR VOICE
Record, pause, resume and play a spoken story. Audio stays in private app storage. The free tier supports recordings up to three minutes. Microphone permission is requested when you choose to record. Command phrases currently support English. Voice commands and spoken playback depend on installed device services; touch and text alternatives remain available.

FOLLOW YOUR FAMILY'S CHAPTERS
Browse saved memories in a timeline. Search written stories, tags and manually edited transcripts. Create scrapbook drafts, arrange pages and add captions.

PRESERVE A COPY YOU CONTROL
Create a local backup and explicitly choose whether to include photographs and recordings. Restore validates the archive before importing. Keep exports and passphrases somewhere safe.

OPTIONAL PREMIUM
Premium is designed as a one-time purchase for unlimited albums, longer recordings, local PDF keepsake export and encrypted archive creation. Actual local prices will be supplied by Amazon. Existing stories remain accessible without Premium.

This listing is a draft. Automatic transcription is not configured. Worldwide translations, required device tests and Amazon purchasing verification are incomplete. No cloud sync is offered. Do not publish this draft as a finished product listing.

LifeTalea gives family stories a private place on your tablet. Begin with one photograph, a few written lines, or a voice recording. No LifeTalea account is required.

Add photographs, tags and an optional location you enter yourself. Choose a year, month, exact date or unknown date. Organise memories into albums and mark favourites.

Browse saved memories in a timeline. Search written stories, tags and manually edited transcripts. Create scrapbook drafts, arrange pages and add captions.

Create a local backup and explicitly choose whether to include photographs and recordings. Restore validates the archive before importing. Keep exports and passphrases somewhere safe.

OPTIONAL PREMIUM
Premium is designed as a one-time purchase for unlimited albums, longer recordings, local PDF keepsake export and encrypted archive creation. Actual local prices will be supplied by Amazon. Existing stories remain accessible without Premium.

source:
Keep the moments. Remember the voices.

LifeTalea gives family stories a private place on your tablet. Begin with one photograph, a few written lines, or a voice recording. No LifeTalea account is required.

SAVE THE STORY BEHIND THE PHOTOGRAPH
Add photographs, tags and an optional location you enter yourself. Choose a year, month, exact date or unknown date. Organise memories into albums and mark favourites.

MAKE ROOM FOR THEIR VOICE
Record, pause, resume and play a spoken story. Audio stays in private app storage. The free tier supports recordings up to three minutes. Microphone permission is requested when you choose to record. Command phrases currently support English. Voice commands and spoken playback depend on installed device services; touch and text alternatives remain available.

FOLLOW YOUR FAMILY'S CHAPTERS
Browse saved memories in a timeline. Search written stories, tags and manually edited transcripts. Create scrapbook drafts, arrange pages and add captions.

PRESERVE A COPY YOU CONTROL
Create a local backup and explicitly choose whether to include photographs and recordings. Restore validates the archive before importing. Keep exports and passphrases somewhere safe.

OPTIONAL PREMIUM
Premium is designed as a one-time purchase for unlimited albums, longer recordings, local PDF keepsake export and encrypted archive creation. Actual local prices will be supplied by Amazon. Existing stories remain accessible without Premium.

DEVELOPMENT STATUS
This listing is a draft. Automatic transcription is not configured. Worldwide translations, required device tests and Amazon purchasing verification are incomplete. No cloud sync is offered. Do not publish this draft as a finished product listing.

LifeTalea Dai storie di famiglia un posto privato sul tuo tablet. Inizia con una foto, alcune righe scritte o una registrazione vocale. No LifeTalea Il conto è richiesto.

Salva la storia dopo la fotografia
Aggiungi foto, tag e una posizione opzionale che inserisci. Scegli un anno, mese, data esatta o data sconosciuta. Organizzare i ricordi in album e segnalare i preferiti.

Fai la tua stanza per la tua voce
Ricordare, riposare, riprendere e giocare una storia raccontata. L'audio rimane in archiviazione app privata. Il piano gratuito supporta le registrazioni fino a 3 minuti. Il permesso per il microfono è richiesto quando si sceglie di registrare. Le frasi di comando attualmente supportano l'inglese. I comandi vocali e le riprese parlate dipendono dai servizi di dispositivi installati; le alternative di tatto e testo rimangono disponibili.

Segui i capitoli della tua famiglia
Browse ha salvato i ricordi in un timeline. Cerca storie scritte, tag e transcrizioni modificate manualmente. Creare disegni scrapbook, organizzare pagine e aggiungere capzioni.

Conservare una copia che controlli
Crea un backup locale e seleziona esplicitamente se includere foto e registrazioni. Ristrutturazione valida l'archivio prima dell'importazione. Mantenere le esportazioni e i passaporti in un luogo sicuro.

Il premio opzionale
Premium è progettato come acquisto a un'unica volta per album illimitati, registrazioni più lunghe, locale PDF Conservare l'esportazione e la creazione di archivi crittografati. I prezzi attuali saranno forniti da Amazon. Le storie esistenti rimangono accessibili senza Premium.

Lo stato di sviluppo
Questo elenco è un progetto. La transcrizione automatica non è configurata. traduzioni globali, test di dispositivi richiesti e Amazon La verifica dell’acquisto è incompleta. Non è offerta alcuna sincronizzazione cloud. Non pubblicare questo progetto come elenco di prodotti finiti.

LifeTalea gives family stories a private place on your tablet. Begin with one photograph, a few written lines, or a voice recording. No LifeTalea account is required.

SAVE THE STORY BEHIND THE PHOTOGRAPH
Add photographs, tags and an optional location you enter yourself. Choose a year, month, exact date or unknown date. Organise memories into albums and mark favourites.

MAKE ROOM FOR THEIR VOICE
Record, pause, resume and play a spoken story. Audio stays in private app storage. The free tier supports recordings up to three minutes. Microphone permission is requested when you choose to record. Browse saved memories in a timeline. Search written stories, tags and manually edited transcripts. Create scrapbook drafts, arrange pages and add captions.

Create a local backup and explicitly choose whether to include photographs and recordings. Restore validates the archive before importing. Keep exports and passphrases somewhere safe.

OPTIONAL PREMIUM
Premium is designed as a one-time purchase for unlimited albums, longer recordings, local PDF keepsake export and encrypted archive creation. Actual local prices will be supplied by Amazon. Existing stories remain accessible without Premium.

This listing is a draft. Automatic transcription is not configured. Worldwide translations, required device tests and Amazon purchasing verification are incomplete. No cloud sync is offered. Do not publish this draft as a finished product listing.

source:
Keep the moments. Remember the voices.

LifeTalea gives family stories a private place on your tablet. Begin with one photograph, a few written lines, or a voice recording. No LifeTalea account is required.

SAVE THE STORY BEHIND THE PHOTOGRAPH
Add photographs, tags and an optional location you enter yourself. Choose a year, month, exact date or unknown date. Organise memories into albums and mark favourites.

MAKE ROOM FOR THEIR VOICE
Record, pause, resume and play a spoken story. Audio stays in private app storage. The free tier supports recordings up to three minutes. Microphone permission is requested when you choose to record. Command phrases currently support English. Voice commands and spoken playback depend on installed device services; touch and text alternatives remain available.

FOLLOW YOUR FAMILY'S CHAPTERS
Browse saved memories in a timeline. Search written stories, tags and manually edited transcripts. Create scrapbook drafts, arrange pages and add captions.

PRESERVE A COPY YOU CONTROL
Create a local backup and explicitly choose whether to include photographs and recordings. Restore validates the archive before importing. Keep exports and passphrases somewhere safe.

OPTIONAL PREMIUM
Premium is designed as a one-time purchase for unlimited albums, longer recordings, local PDF keepsake export and encrypted archive creation. Actual local prices will be supplied by Amazon. Existing stories remain accessible without Premium.

DEVELOPMENT STATUS
This listing is a draft. Automatic transcription is not configured. Worldwide translations, required device tests and Amazon purchasing verification are incomplete. No cloud sync is offered. Do not publish this draft as a finished product listing.

source:
Keep the moments. Remember the voices.

LifeTalea gives family stories a private place on your tablet. Begin with one photograph, a few written lines, or a voice recording. No LifeTalea account is required.

SAVE THE STORY BEHIND THE PHOTOGRAPH
Add photographs, tags and an optional location you enter yourself. Choose a year, month, exact date or unknown date. Organise memories into albums and mark favourites.

MAKE ROOM FOR THEIR VOICE
Record, pause, resume and play a spoken story. Audio stays in private app storage. The free tier supports recordings up to three minutes. Microphone permission is requested when you choose to record. Command phrases currently support English. Voice commands and spoken playback depend on installed device services; touch and text alternatives remain available.

FOLLOW YOUR FAMILY'S CHAPTERS
Browse saved memories in a timeline. Search written stories, tags and manually edited transcripts. Create scrapbook drafts, arrange pages and add captions.

PRESERVE A COPY YOU CONTROL
Create a local backup and explicitly choose whether to include photographs and recordings. Restore validates the archive before importing. Keep exports and passphrases somewhere safe.

OPTIONAL PREMIUM
Premium is designed as a one-time purchase for unlimited albums, longer recordings, local PDF keepsake export and encrypted archive creation. Actual local prices will be supplied by Amazon. Existing stories remain accessible without Premium.

DEVELOPMENT STATUS
This listing is a draft. Automatic transcription is not configured. Worldwide translations, required device tests and Amazon purchasing verification are incomplete. No cloud sync is offered. Do not publish this draft as a finished product listing.

SAVE THE STORY BEHIND THE PHOTOGRAPH
Add photographs, tags and an optional location you enter yourself. Choose a year, month, exact date or unknown date. Organise memories into albums and mark favourites.

MAKE ROOM FOR THEIR VOICE
Record, pause, resume and play a spoken story. Audio stays in private app storage. The free tier supports recordings up to three minutes. Microphone permission is requested when you choose to record. Command phrases currently support English. Voice commands and spoken playback depend on installed device services; touch and text alternatives remain available.

FOLLOW YOUR FAMILY'S CHAPTERS
Browse saved memories in a timeline. Search written stories, tags and manually edited transcripts. Create scrapbook drafts, arrange pages and add captions.

PRESERVE A COPY YOU CONTROL
Create a local backup and explicitly choose whether to include photographs and recordings. Restore validates the archive before importing. Keep exports and passphrases somewhere safe.

OPTIONAL PREMIUM
Premium is designed as a one-time purchase for unlimited albums, longer recordings, local PDF keepsake export and encrypted archive creation. Actual local prices will be supplied by Amazon. Existing stories remain accessible without Premium.

DEVELOPMENT STATUS
This listing is a draft. Automatic transcription is not configured. Worldwide translations, required device tests and Amazon purchasing verification are incomplete. No cloud sync is offered. Do not publish this draft as a finished product listing.

Keep the moments. Remember the voices.

LifeTalea gives family stories a private place on your tablet. Begin with one photograph, a few written lines, or a voice recording. No LifeTalea account is required.

SAVE THE STORY BEHIND THE PHOTOGRAPH
Add photographs, tags and an optional location you enter yourself. Choose a year, month, exact date or unknown date. Organise memories into albums and mark favourites.

MAKE ROOM FOR THEIR VOICE
Record, pause, resume and play a spoken story. Audio stays in private app storage. The free tier supports recordings up to three minutes. Microphone permission is requested when you choose to record. Command phrases currently support English. Voice commands and spoken playback depend on installed device services; touch and text alternatives remain available.

FOLLOW YOUR FAMILY'S CHAPTERS
Browse saved memories in a timeline. Search written stories, tags and manually edited transcripts. Create scrapbook drafts, arrange pages and add captions.

PRESERVE A COPY YOU CONTROL
Create a local backup and explicitly choose whether to include photographs and recordings. Restore validates the archive before importing. Keep exports and passphrases somewhere safe.

OPTIONAL PREMIUM
Premium is designed as a one-time purchase for unlimited albums, longer recordings, local PDF keepsake export and encrypted archive creation. Actual local prices will be supplied by Amazon. Existing stories remain accessible without Premium.

DEVELOPMENT STATUS
This listing is a draft. Automatic transcription is not configured. Worldwide translations, required device tests and Amazon purchasing verification are incomplete. No cloud sync is offered. Do not publish this draft as a finished product listing.

source:
Keep the moments. Remember the voices.

LifeTalea gives family stories a private place on your tablet. Begin with one photograph, a few written lines, or a voice recording. No LifeTalea account is required.

SAVE THE STORY BEHIND THE PHOTOGRAPH
Add photographs, tags and an optional location you enter yourself. Choose a year, month, exact date or unknown date. Organise memories into albums and mark favourites.

MAKE ROOM FOR THEIR VOICE
Record, pause, resume and play a spoken story. Audio stays in private app storage. The free tier supports recordings up to three minutes. Microphone permission is requested when you choose to record. Command phrases currently support English. Voice commands and spoken playback depend on installed device services; touch and text alternatives remain available.

FOLLOW YOUR FAMILY'S CHAPTERS
Browse saved memories in a timeline. Search written stories, tags and manually edited transcripts. Create scrapbook drafts, arrange pages and add captions.

PRESERVE A COPY YOU CONTROL
Create a local backup and explicitly choose whether to include photographs and recordings. Restore validates the archive before importing. Keep exports and passphrases somewhere safe.

OPTIONAL PREMIUM
Premium is designed as a one-time purchase for unlimited albums, longer recordings, local PDF keepsake export and encrypted archive creation. Actual local prices will be supplied by Amazon. Existing stories remain accessible without Premium.

DEVELOPMENT STATUS
This listing is a draft. Automatic transcription is not configured. Worldwide translations, required device tests and Amazon purchasing verification are incomplete. No cloud sync is offered. Do not publish this draft as a finished product listing.

Keep the moments. Remember the voices.

LifeTalea gives family stories a private place on your tablet. Begin with one photograph, a few written lines, or a voice recording. No LifeTalea account is required.

SAVE THE STORY BEHIND THE PHOTOGRAPH
Add photographs, tags and an optional location you enter yourself. Choose a year, month, exact date or unknown date. Organise memories into albums and mark favourites.

MAKE ROOM FOR THEIR VOICE
Record, pause, resume and play a spoken story. Audio stays in private app storage. The free tier supports recordings up to three minutes. Microphone permission is requested when you choose to record. Command phrases currently support English. Voice commands and spoken playback depend on installed device services; touch and text alternatives remain available.

FOLLOW YOUR FAMILY'S CHAPTERS
Browse saved memories in a timeline. Search written stories, tags and manually edited transcripts. Create scrapbook drafts, arrange pages and add captions.

PRESERVE A COPY YOU CONTROL
Create a local backup and explicitly choose whether to include photographs and recordings. Restore validates the archive before importing. Keep exports and passphrases somewhere safe.

OPTIONAL PREMIUM
Premium is designed as a one-time purchase for unlimited albums, longer recordings, local PDF keepsake export and encrypted archive creation. Actual local prices will be supplied by Amazon. Existing stories remain accessible without Premium.

DEVELOPMENT STATUS
This listing is a draft. Automatic transcription is not configured. Worldwide translations, required device tests and Amazon purchasing verification are incomplete. No cloud sync is offered. Do not publish this draft as a finished product listing.

क्षणों को पकड़ो। आवाजों को याद रखें।

LifeTalea परिवार की कहानियों को अपने टैबलेट पर एक निजी स्थान देता है। एक तस्वीर, कुछ लिखित पंक्तियों, या एक वॉयस रिकॉर्डिंग के साथ शुरू करें। नहीं LifeTalea अकाउंट की जरूरत है।

तस्वीरों के पीछे की कहानी बचाएं
तस्वीरें, टैग और एक वैकल्पिक स्थान जो आप स्वयं दर्ज करते हैं जोड़ें। एक वर्ष, महीने, सटीक तारीख या अज्ञात तारीख का चयन करें। स्मृतियों को एल्बम में व्यवस्थित करें और पसंदीदा चिह्नित करें।

अपनी आवाज के लिए कमरे बनाएं
रिकॉर्ड करें, रुकें, पुनरावृत्ति करें और एक बातचीत की कहानी खेलें। ऑडियो निजी ऐप स्टोरेज में रहता है। मुफ्त स्तर तीन मिनट तक रिकॉर्डिंग का समर्थन करता है। जब आप रिकॉर्डिंग का चयन करते हैं तो माइक्रोफोन अनुमति मांगी जाती है। कमांड वाक्यांश वर्तमान में अंग्रेजी का समर्थन करते हैं। वॉयस कमांड और बोलने वाले प्लेबैक स्थापित डिवाइस सेवाओं पर निर्भर करते हैं; स्पर्श और पाठ विकल्प उपलब्ध रहते हैं।

अपने परिवार के अध्यायों का पालन करें
Browse एक टाइमलाइन में स्मृतियों को बचाता है। लिखित कहानियों, टैग और मैन्युअल रूप से संपादित ट्रांसक्रिप्ट की खोज करें। स्क्रैपबुक डिजाइन बनाएं, पृष्ठों को व्यवस्थित करें और कब्जे जोड़ें।

एक कॉपी रखें जिसे आप नियंत्रित करते हैं
एक स्थानीय बैकअप बनाएं और स्पष्ट रूप से चुनें कि क्या तस्वीरें और रिकॉर्डिंग शामिल करें। पुनर्स्थापना आयात करने से पहले संग्रह को सत्यापित करता है। आयात और पासवर्ड कहीं सुरक्षित रखें।

विकल्प प्रीमियम
प्रीमियम असीमित एल्बम, लंबे समय तक रिकॉर्डिंग, स्थानीय के लिए एक बार खरीद के रूप में डिज़ाइन किया गया है PDF बनाए रखें निर्यात और एन्क्रिप्टेड संग्रह बनाना। मौजूदा स्थानीय कीमतों की आपूर्ति की जाएगी Amazon. मौजूदा कहानियां बिना प्रीमियम के उपलब्ध रहती हैं।

विकास की स्थिति
यह सूची एक योजना है। स्वचालित ट्रांस्क्रिप्शन स्थापित नहीं किया गया है। वैश्विक अनुवाद, आवश्यक डिवाइस परीक्षण और Amazon खरीद की पुष्टि अपूर्ण है। कोई क्लाउड सिंक्रनाइज़ेशन की पेशकश नहीं की जाती है। इस प्रस्ताव को एक समाप्त उत्पाद सूची के रूप में प्रकाशित न करें।

source:
Keep the moments. Remember the voices.

LifeTalea gives family stories a private place on your tablet. Begin with one photograph, a few written lines, or a voice recording. No LifeTalea account is required.

SAVE THE STORY BEHIND THE PHOTOGRAPH
Add photographs, tags and an optional location you enter yourself. Choose a year, month, exact date or unknown date. Organise memories into albums and mark favourites.

MAKE ROOM FOR THEIR VOICE
Record, pause, resume and play a spoken story. Audio stays in private app storage. The free tier supports recordings up to three minutes. Microphone permission is requested when you choose to record. Command phrases currently support English. Voice commands and spoken playback depend on installed device services; touch and text alternatives remain available.

FOLLOW YOUR FAMILY'S CHAPTERS
Browse saved memories in a timeline. Search written stories, tags and manually edited transcripts. Create scrapbook drafts, arrange pages and add captions.

PRESERVE A COPY YOU CONTROL
Create a local backup and explicitly choose whether to include photographs and recordings. Restore validates the archive before importing. Keep exports and passphrases somewhere safe.

OPTIONAL PREMIUM
Premium is designed as a one-time purchase for unlimited albums, longer recordings, local PDF keepsake export and encrypted archive creation. Actual local prices will be supplied by Amazon. Existing stories remain accessible without Premium.

source:
Keep the moments. Remember the voices.

LifeTalea gives family stories a private place on your tablet. Begin with one photograph, a few written lines, or a voice recording. No LifeTalea account is required.

SAVE THE STORY BEHIND THE PHOTOGRAPH
Add photographs, tags and an optional location you enter yourself. Choose a year, month, exact date or unknown date. Organise memories into albums and mark favourites.

MAKE ROOM FOR THEIR VOICE
Record, pause, resume and play a spoken story. Audio stays in private app storage. The free tier supports recordings up to three minutes. Microphone permission is requested when you choose to record. Command phrases currently support English. Voice commands and spoken playback depend on installed device services; touch and text alternatives remain available.

FOLLOW YOUR FAMILY'S CHAPTERS
Browse saved memories in a timeline. Search written stories, tags and manually edited transcripts. Create scrapbook drafts, arrange pages and add captions.

PRESERVE A COPY YOU CONTROL
Create a local backup and explicitly choose whether to include photographs and recordings. Restore validates the archive before importing. Keep exports and passphrases somewhere safe.

OPTIONAL PREMIUM
Premium is designed as a one-time purchase for unlimited albums, longer recordings, local PDF keepsake export and encrypted archive creation. Actual local prices will be supplied by Amazon. Existing stories remain accessible without Premium.

DEVELOPMENT STATUS
This listing is a draft. Automatic transcription is not configured. Worldwide translations, required device tests and Amazon purchasing verification are incomplete. No cloud sync is offered. Do not publish this draft as a finished product listing.

Bu anları tutun. Sesleri hatırlayın.

LifeTalea Aile hikayeleri tabletinizde özel bir yer verin. Bir fotoğraf, birkaç yazılı çizgi veya bir ses kaydı ile başlayın. Hayır LifeTalea Hesap gerektirir.

source:
Keep the moments. Remember the voices.

LifeTalea gives family stories a private place on your tablet. Begin with one photograph, a few written lines, or a voice recording. No LifeTalea account is required.

SAVE THE STORY BEHIND THE PHOTOGRAPH
Add photographs, tags and an optional location you enter yourself. Choose a year, month, exact date or unknown date. Organise memories into albums and mark favourites.

MAKE ROOM FOR THEIR VOICE
Record, pause, resume and play a spoken story. Audio stays in private app storage. The free tier supports recordings up to three minutes. Microphone permission is requested when you choose to record. Command phrases currently support English. Voice commands and spoken playback depend on installed device services; touch and text alternatives remain available.

FOLLOW YOUR FAMILY'S CHAPTERS
Browse saved memories in a timeline. Search written stories, tags and manually edited transcripts. Create scrapbook drafts, arrange pages and add captions.

PRESERVE A COPY YOU CONTROL
Create a local backup and explicitly choose whether to include photographs and recordings. Restore validates the archive before importing. Keep exports and passphrases somewhere safe.

OPTIONAL PREMIUM
Premium is designed as a one-time purchase for unlimited albums, longer recordings, local PDF keepsake export and encrypted archive creation. Actual local prices will be supplied by Amazon. Existing stories remain accessible without Premium.

DEVELOPMENT STATUS
This listing is a draft. Automatic transcription is not configured. Worldwide translations, required device tests and Amazon purchasing verification are incomplete. No cloud sync is offered. Do not publish this draft as a finished product listing.

source:
Keep the moments. Remember the voices.

LifeTalea gives family stories a private place on your tablet. Begin with one photograph, a few written lines, or a voice recording. No LifeTalea account is required.

SAVE THE STORY BEHIND THE PHOTOGRAPH
Add photographs, tags and an optional location you enter yourself. Choose a year, month, exact date or unknown date. Organise memories into albums and mark favourites.

MAKE ROOM FOR THEIR VOICE
Record, pause, resume and play a spoken story. Audio stays in private app storage. The free tier supports recordings up to three minutes. Microphone permission is requested when you choose to record. Command phrases currently support English. Voice commands and spoken playback depend on installed device services; touch and text alternatives remain available.

FOLLOW YOUR FAMILY'S CHAPTERS
Browse saved memories in a timeline. Search written stories, tags and manually edited transcripts. Create scrapbook drafts, arrange pages and add captions.

PRESERVE A COPY YOU CONTROL
Create a local backup and explicitly choose whether to include photographs and recordings. Restore validates the archive before importing. Keep exports and passphrases somewhere safe.

OPTIONAL PREMIUM
Premium is designed as a one-time purchase for unlimited albums, longer recordings, local PDF keepsake export and encrypted archive creation. Actual local prices will be supplied by Amazon. Existing stories remain accessible without Premium.

DEVELOPMENT STATUS
This listing is a draft. Automatic transcription is not configured. Worldwide translations, required device tests and Amazon purchasing verification are incomplete. No cloud sync is offered. Do not publish this draft as a finished product listing.

source:
Keep the moments. Remember the voices.

LifeTalea gives family stories a private place on your tablet. Begin with one photograph, a few written lines, or a voice recording. No LifeTalea account is required.

SAVE THE STORY BEHIND THE PHOTOGRAPH
Add photographs, tags and an optional location you enter yourself. Choose a year, month, exact date or unknown date. Organise memories into albums and mark favourites.

MAKE ROOM FOR THEIR VOICE
Record, pause, resume and play a spoken story. Audio stays in private app storage. The free tier supports recordings up to three minutes. Microphone permission is requested when you choose to record. Command phrases currently support English. Voice commands and spoken playback depend on installed device services; touch and text alternatives remain available.

FOLLOW YOUR FAMILY'S CHAPTERS
Browse saved memories in a timeline. Search written stories, tags and manually edited transcripts. Create scrapbook drafts, arrange pages and add captions.

PRESERVE A COPY YOU CONTROL
Create a local backup and explicitly choose whether to include photographs and recordings. Restore validates the archive before importing. Keep exports and passphrases somewhere safe.

OPTIONAL PREMIUM
Premium is designed as a one-time purchase for unlimited albums, longer recordings, local PDF keepsake export and encrypted archive creation. Actual local prices will be supplied by Amazon. Existing stories remain accessible without Premium.

DEVELOPMENT STATUS
This listing is a draft. Automatic transcription is not configured. Worldwide translations, required device tests and Amazon purchasing verification are incomplete. No cloud sync is offered. Do not publish this draft as a finished product listing.

source:
Keep the moments. Remember the voices.

LifeTalea gives family stories a private place on your tablet. Begin with one photograph, a few written lines, or a voice recording. No LifeTalea account is required.

SAVE THE STORY BEHIND THE PHOTOGRAPH
Add photographs, tags and an optional location you enter yourself. Choose a year, month, exact date or unknown date. Organise memories into albums and mark favourites.

MAKE ROOM FOR THEIR VOICE
Record, pause, resume and play a spoken story. Audio stays in private app storage. The free tier supports recordings up to three minutes. Microphone permission is requested when you choose to record. Command phrases currently support English. Voice commands and spoken playback depend on installed device services; touch and text alternatives remain available.

FOLLOW YOUR FAMILY'S CHAPTERS
Browse saved memories in a timeline. Search written stories, tags and manually edited transcripts. Create scrapbook drafts, arrange pages and add captions.

PRESERVE A COPY YOU CONTROL
Create a local backup and explicitly choose whether to include photographs and recordings. Restore validates the archive before importing. Keep exports and passphrases somewhere safe.

OPTIONAL PREMIUM
Premium is designed as a one-time purchase for unlimited albums, longer recordings, local PDF keepsake export and encrypted archive creation. Actual local prices will be supplied by Amazon. Existing stories remain accessible without Premium.

DEVELOPMENT STATUS
This listing is a draft. Automatic transcription is not configured. Worldwide translations, required device tests and Amazon purchasing verification are incomplete. No cloud sync is offered. Do not publish this draft as a finished product listing.
